title: Dembé residents protest recurring flooding and call on authorities for help
location: Dembé neighborhood near the National Retirement Fund, N’Djaména
scope: Neighborhood residents affected by recurrent flooding.
threshold_50_evidence: No count or qualitative turnout estimate; threshold unresolved.

start_date.summary: Article dates the protests to the morning of 26 August 2025.

location.summary: Dembé neighborhood near the National Retirement Fund, N’Djaména.

demands.summary: Residents called on high authorities to help and denounced recurring flooding and state inaction; they also blamed a nearby retention basin.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No numeric or descriptive estimate sufficient to assess 50 simultaneous participants.

state_target.summary: Residents explicitly said the state did nothing and called on high authorities for help.

state_response.summary: Police intervened to contain the protest movement and remained deployed; text does not report dispersal, arrests or violence.

notes: Actual protest occurrence is reported; attendance remains unverified. Do not infer crowd size from the neighborhood population or number of affected homes.
open_questions: Is there an independent contemporaneous estimate of simultaneous participants in the Dembé protest?
Did police presence lead to dispersal, arrests, or another documented response, or was the crowd only contained?
